```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(highcharter)
library(scales)

df <- read_csv("data/io_exposures.csv")

# Keep only "real" commodity/industry rows (drop value-added & final-use
# aggregate rows whose code starts with V or F, and rows with no label)
io <- df |>
  filter(!str_starts(industry_naics, "[A-Z]"),
         !is.na(t_row_label),
         t_row_label != "NA") |>
  select(year, industry_naics, t_row_label,
         T001, T005, T006, T007, T008, omega_mfg, omega_import) |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))

t_vars <- c("T001", "T005", "T006", "T007", "T008")

# Human-readable labels for the five exposure measures.
# Edit these to match your exact BEA definitions.
t_labels <- c(
  T001 = "T001 — Total Intermediate Inputs",
  T005 = "T005 — Total Industry Output",
  T006 = "T006 — Total Commodity Output",
  T007 = "T007 — Total Final Uses",
  T008 = "T008 — Total Use of Commodities"
)

years <- sort(unique(io$year))
latest_year <- max(years)

io_long <- io |>
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(t_vars), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(measure_label = t_labels[measure])
```

# Overview

```{r}

```

## Row {height="80%"}

### Column {width="55%"}

```{r}
#| title: Top 15 industries by T001 — Total Intermediate Inputs
top15 <- io |>
  filter(year == latest_year) |>
  slice_max(order_by = T001, n = 15) |>
  arrange(desc(T001))

hchart(top15, "bar", hcaes(x = t_row_label, y = T001), name = "T001") |>
  hc_xAxis(title = list(text = NULL)) |>
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "USD (millions)")) |>
  hc_title(text = paste("Top 15 industries by T001 —", latest_year)) |>
  hc_tooltip(valueDecimals = 0, valuePrefix = "$") |>
  hc_add_theme(hc_theme_google())
```

```{r}
#| title: Top 15 industries by T008 — Total Use of Commodities
top15 <- io |>
  filter(year == latest_year) |>
  slice_max(order_by = T008, n = 15) |>
  arrange(desc(T008))

hchart(top15, "bar", hcaes(x = t_row_label, y = T008), name = "T008") |>
  hc_xAxis(title = list(text = NULL)) |>
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "USD (millions)")) |>
  hc_title(text = paste("Top 15 industries by T008 —", latest_year)) |>
  hc_tooltip(valueDecimals = 0, valuePrefix = "$") |>

```

### Column {width="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: Aggregate trend of T001–T008 across years
agg <- io_long |>
  group_by(year, measure, measure_label) |>
  summarise(total = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

hchart(agg, "area", hcaes(x = year, y = total, group = measure_label)) |>
  hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "Year"), categories = years) |>
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "USD (millions)")) |>
  hc_title(text = "Sum across all industries, by year") |>
  hc_tooltip(valueDecimals = 0, valuePrefix = "$", shared = TRUE) |>
  hc_add_theme(hc_theme_google())
```

```{r}
#| title: Distribution of T001–T008 (latest year)

dist_data <- io |> filter(year == latest_year)

# Use a common set of breaks across all five variables so bins line up
all_vals <- dist_data |>
  select(all_of(t_vars)) |>
  unlist() |>
  na.omit()

breaks <- pretty(all_vals, n = 20)

hist_df <- map_dfr(t_vars, function(v) {
  h <- hist(dist_data[[v]], breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)
  tibble(
    measure = v,
    measure_label = t_labels[v],
    bin_mid = h$mids,
    count = h$counts
  )
})

hchart(hist_df, "area", hcaes(x = bin_mid, y = count, group = measure_label),
       step = "center") |>
  hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "USD (millions)")) |>
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Number of industries")) |>
  hc_title(text = paste("Distribution of T001–T008 —", latest_year)) |>
  hc_tooltip(shared = FALSE, valueDecimals = 0) |>
  hc_add_theme(hc_theme_google())
```

# Ranking

## Row

Ranking of industries — choose the tab for each exposure measure

```{r}
panels <- map(t_vars, function(v) {
  d <- io |>
    filter(year == latest_year) |>
    slice_max(order_by = .data[[v]], n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    arrange(desc(.data[[v]]))

  hchart(d, "bar", hcaes(x = t_row_label, y = .data[[v]]), name = v) |>
    hc_xAxis(title = list(text = NULL)) |>
    hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "USD (millions)")) |>
    hc_title(text = paste0(t_labels[v], " — ", latest_year)) |>
    hc_tooltip(valueDecimals = 0, valuePrefix = "$") |>
    hc_add_theme(hc_theme_google())
})
```

::: panel-tabset
```{r}
#| output: asis
for (i in seq_along(t_vars)) {
  cat("## ", t_vars[i], "\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(panels[[i]]))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
:::

## Row {height="60%"}

Trends by Industry

```{r}
panels_trend <- map(t_vars, function(v) {
  top_ind <- io |>
    filter(year == latest_year) |>
    slice_max(order_by = .data[[v]], n = 10) |>
    pull(t_row_label)

  trend_df <- io |>
    filter(t_row_label %in% top_ind)
  
  hchart(trend_df, "line", hcaes(x = year, y = .data[[v]], group = t_row_label)) |>
    hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "Year"), categories = years) |>
    hc_yAxis(title = list(text = paste(t_labels[v], "(USD millions)"))) |>
    hc_title(text = paste(t_labels[v], "Top 10 industries", sep = " - ")) |>
    hc_tooltip(valueDecimals = 0, valuePrefix = "$") |>
    hc_legend(enabled = TRUE) |> 
    hc_add_theme(hc_theme_google())
  })

```

::: panel-tabset
```{r}
#| output: asis
for (i in seq_along(t_vars)) {
    cat("## ", t_vars[i], "\n\n")
    print(htmltools::tagList(panels_trend[[i]]))
    cat("\n\n")
}
```
:::

## Row {height="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: Manufacturing-input exposure (omega_mfg) vs. T001
highchart() |>
  hc_add_series(
    io |> filter(year == 2007), type = "scatter",
    hcaes(x = omega_mfg*100, y = T001), name = "2007"
  ) |> 
  hc_add_series(
    io |> filter(year == 2012), type = "scatter",
    hcaes(x = omega_mfg*100, y = T001), name = "2012"
  ) |> 
  hc_add_series(
    io |> filter(year == 2017), type = "scatter",
    hcaes(x = omega_mfg*100, y = T001), name = "2017"
  ) |> 
  hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "omega_mfg (share of manufacturing inputs)"),
           labels = list(format = "{value:,.0f}%")) |>
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "T001 (USD millions)")) |>
  hc_title(text = "Manufacturing-input exposure vs. T001") |>
  hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "<b>{point.name}</b><br>omega_mfg: {point.x:.02f}%<br>T001: ${point.y:.02f}") |>
  hc_add_theme(hc_theme_google())
```

# Data Table

```{r}
#| title: Underlying data (latest year)
io |>
  arrange(industry_naics, year) |>
  DT::datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE),
    colnames = c("NAICS", "Industry", 
                 "T001 — Total Intermediate Inputs", "T005 — Total Industry Output", 
                 "T006 — Total Commodity Output", "T007 — Total Final Uses", "T008 — Total Use of Commodities",
                 "Omega (mfg)", "Omega (import)")
  ) |>
  DT::formatCurrency(columns = t_vars, currency = "$", digits = 0) |>
  DT::formatPercentage(columns = c("omega_mfg", "omega_import"), digits = 1)
```
